bearingSource: OSM way 1108116335 long axis 62.4°; +X points to the polygonal altar apse (east-north-east), the open porch faces −X (photos 01, 02, 05); photo 01 shows the south side (+Z).
approximations: OSM outline (24.8 × 12.0 m) read as the roof outline with ≈ 1 m deep eaves; walls 10 m wide with polygonal lateral conchs. Heights estimated from the west-front photographs (podium ≈ 1.25 m, eave ≈ 8.8 m, towers ≈ 21–22 m to the cross). Porch depth and the number of side arches estimated; lobed arches, carved capitals and painted ornament reduced to coloured frames, lobes and bands; north side mirrored; scaffolding and the separate bell tower (04) not modelled. Copper roofs, tower caps and rainwater goods as photographed in April 2023.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii publice din aprilie 2023 și conturul OSM; înălțimile sunt estimate, iar ornamentația brâncovenească (arcade trilobate, capiteluri, pictura fațadelor) este simplificată. Acoperișurile, coifurile turlelor și jgheaburile de cupru sunt redate așa cum apar în fotografiile de după restaurare.
note.hu: A 2023 áprilisi nyilvános fotók és az OSM-körvonal alapján értelmezett makett; a magasságok becsültek, a brâncoveanui díszítés (háromkaréjos árkádok, oszlopfők, homlokzatfestés) egyszerűsített. A rézfedés, a toronysisakok és a réz ereszcsatornák a restaurálás utáni fotók szerint jelennek meg.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public photographs of April 2023 and the OSM outline; heights are estimated and the Brâncovenesc ornament (lobed arcades, capitals, painted façades) is simplified. The copper roofs, tower caps and rainwater goods are shown as photographed after the restoration.
